metadata.title: Send quote | Slashie
metadata.description: Send a clear quote for a Slashie task with price, message, and availability.
metadata.taskDescription: Review {title} and send your quote on Slashie.

en.title: Send a quote
en.description: Share your price, timing, and why you are a good fit for this task.
en.notFoundDescription: This task may have been removed or is no longer available for quotes.
en.slotsInvalid: Add at least one time with a day and a start time in the future.
en.locationNote: Approximate area. The exact address is shared once a quote is accepted.

quote.price.label: Your price
quote.price.title: Your price
quote.price.description: Enter the total price you would like to charge for this task.

quote.message.label: Message
quote.message.title: Message to customer
quote.message.description: Introduce yourself and explain how you will complete the job.

quote.availability.label: Times
quote.availability.title: When can you do the work?
quote.availability.description: Offer one or two exact times. The customer picks one when they accept your quote.

quote.photos.label: Photos
quote.photos.title: Add photos
quote.photos.description: Optional. Add photos of your previous work. Uploads are not sent with the quote yet.

review.check.label: Review
review.check.title: Review your quote
review.check.description: Check your details before sending your quote to the customer.

price.label: Your quote
price.helper: Enter the total price you'd like to charge.
price.helperWithBudget: Customer budget: {budget}. Enter the total price you'd like to charge.

message.label: Message to customer
message.tooLong: Message must be {max} characters or fewer.

review.terms: By sending, you agree to Slashie's {terms}. Payment is arranged directly between you and the customer outside Slashie.

privateCallout.title: Quotes are private
privateCallout.body: Your quote will be visible to the customer once you send it.

gate.signInBody: Sign in to send a quote for this task.
gate.workerProfileBody: Create your worker profile before you can send quotes.
gate.limitBody: You've used this month's free quotes. Quotes you've already sent stay editable.

metadata.title: 傳送報價 | Slashie
metadata.description: 為 Slashie 任務傳送清晰報價，包括價錢、訊息和可提供時間。
metadata.taskDescription: 查看「{title}」，然後在 Slashie 傳送你的報價。

zh_hk.title: 傳送報價
zh_hk.description: 分享你的價錢、時間，以及為何適合這個任務。
zh_hk.notFoundDescription: 此任務可能已移除，或已不再接受報價。
zh_hk.slotsInvalid: 請最少加入一個時間，包括日期和未來的開始時間。
zh_hk.locationNote: 大約位置。報價被接受後才會提供確實地址。

quote.price.label: 你的價錢
quote.price.title: 你的價錢
quote.price.description: 輸入你為這個任務收取的總價錢。

quote.message.label: 訊息
quote.message.title: 給顧客的訊息
quote.message.description: 介紹你自己，並說明你會如何完成這份工作。

quote.availability.label: 時間
quote.availability.title: 你甚麼時候可以開工？
quote.availability.description: 提供一至兩個確實時間。顧客接受你的報價時會揀選其中一個。

quote.photos.label: 相片
quote.photos.title: 加入相片
quote.photos.description: 選填。加入你過往工作的相片。上載的相片暫時不會隨報價一併傳送。

review.check.label: 檢查
review.check.title: 檢查你的報價
review.check.description: 傳送報價給顧客前，請先檢查你的資料。

price.label: 你的報價
price.helper: 輸入你想收取的總價錢。
price.helperWithBudget: 顧客預算：{budget}。輸入你想收取的總價錢。

message.label: 給顧客的訊息
message.tooLong: 訊息不可超過 {max} 個字。

review.terms: 傳送即表示你同意 Slashie 的{terms}。付款由你與顧客在 Slashie 以外直接安排。

privateCallout.title: 報價不會公開
privateCallout.body: 你傳送報價後，顧客便會看到。

gate.signInBody: 登入後即可為此任務傳送報價。
gate.workerProfileBody: 傳送報價前，請先建立你的工作者檔案。
gate.limitBody: 你已用完本月的免費報價。已傳送的報價仍可修改。
